title: A Unified Assessment of the Poverty of the Stimulus Argument for Neural Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.09992v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Several recent contributions have evaluated the Poverty of the Stimulus Hypothesis (PoSH) using Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The results suggest that ANN-based language models can acquire certain structure-dependent generalizations from limited input without structural inductive biases of the type traditionally hypothesized by linguists. However, existing studies have largely focused on individual phenomena and adopted different evaluation protocols, leaving it unclear whether previous findings generalize across phenomena and learning conditions. We introduce \poshbench, a unified benchmark covering four canonical PoS phenomena. Training Transformer, LSTM, and n-gram models, we find that ANN-based models can achieve above-chance generalization from surprisingly limited input (10M words), but they show less efficient learning than children as input scale grows. translated_title: 神经语言模型刺激贫乏论证的统一评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.09992v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：近期多项研究使用人工神经网络（ANNs）评估了刺激贫乏假说（PoSH）。结果表明，基于ANN的语言模型可以在没有语言学家传统假设的结构性归纳偏置的情况下，从有限输入中获取某些结构依赖的概括能力。然而，现有研究大多聚焦于个别现象，并采用了不同的评估协议，这使得先前发现是否适用于各种现象和学习条件仍不明确。我们引入了\poshbench，一个覆盖四个经典PoS现象的统一基准。通过训练Transformer、LSTM和n-gram模型，我们发现基于ANN的模型可以从令人惊讶的有限输入（1000万词）中实现高于偶然水平的概括，但随着输入规模增长，其学习效率低于儿童。此外，认知动机驱动的归纳偏置显著提升了性能。
tldr: 本研究提出了一个统一基准，系统评估了神经语言模型在刺激贫乏假说下的表现，发现它们能从有限输入中实现概括，但学习效率低于儿童，且认知偏置能显著改善性能。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a unified benchmark to systematically evaluate neural language models under the Poverty of the Stimulus Hypothesis, finding they can generalize from limited input but learn less efficiently than children, with cognitive biases substantially improving performance.
